description: Turn churchit modules on or off for this church. Disabled modules are hidden from the desk.

fields.options: Unchecking a module hides its workspaces and its icon in the app switcher for everyone, and drops its dashboards, charts and number cards from the desk. Nothing is deleted and no permissions change, so records stay reachable by direct link for anyone who already has access. Re-check the box to bring the module back exactly as it was.
